health-illness.sampleAnswer: Yes, sometimes. I feel stressed when I have a lot of work, but exercise helps me relax.
sampleAnswerIpa: /jes | ˈsʌmtaɪmz/
/aɪ fiːl strest wen aɪ hæv ə lɒt əv wɜːk/
/bət ˈeksəsaɪz helps mi rɪˈlæks/

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have a headache/toothache?
answerFrames: If you have a headache, you should rest.
If you have a toothache, you should go to the dentist.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: If I have a headache, I should rest and take a nap. If I have a toothache, I should go to the dentist.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪf aɪ hæv ə ˈhedeɪk | aɪ ʃʊd rest ænd teɪk ə næp/
/ɪf aɪ hæv ə ˈtuːθeɪk | aɪ ʃʊd ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈdentɪst/

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have got a cold?
answerFrames: If you have got a cold, you should rest.
health-illness.sampleAnswer: If I have got a cold, I should rest and go to bed early. I should also drink a lot of warm water.
sampleAnswerIpa: /ɪf aɪ həv ɡɒt ə kəʊld | aɪ ʃʊd rest ænd ɡəʊ tə bed ˈɜːli/
/aɪ ʃʊd ˈɔːlsəʊ drɪŋk ə lɒt əv wɔːm ˈwɔːtə/
